card.name: Inside MALIGNANCIES and similar split words
card.fires_on: The middle piece of a word split into parts, mostly "ANC" in capitalized MALIGNANCY/MALIGNANCIES headings and in BALANCING. It also fires on pieces inside names and romanized words, like "ym" in a username.

modes.label: ANC in MALIGNANCIES
modes.description: The "ANC" piece in all-caps MALIGNANCY or MALIGNANCIES in warning headings.
modes.example: WARNING: MALIGN<<ANC>>IES AND SERIOUS INFECTIONS Increased

modes.label: Other split names
modes.description: A middle piece of a username or romanized Chinese formula name.
modes.example: Professor Andy Miah (@and<<ym>>iah) is Director of the Creative Futures

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle chunk of the all-caps word MALIGNANCIES, and occasionally on chunks of unusual names.
